features.name: Workflow node pipeline
features.description: Coordinate data, web search, schemer, evaluator, reviser, and agent state transitions.
features.evidence: WorkflowEvent/WorkflowEventSink/SseWorkflowEventSink seam added on 2026-05-31. Python EXAONE reliability work added confirmed-invalid semantics, bounded per-node retry with state rollback, four-stage evaluation, isolated revision with safe fallback, and SSE heartbeat coverage. On 2026-08-13 raw structured-output and retry diagnostics identified deterministic z=3.98 schema-validator conflict; score is now a model-visible inline numeric enum covering 1.0-5.0 in tenth steps. Reviser preserves source-backed persuasive rewriting, validates complete/grounded answers separately from auxiliary explanations, restores omitted numeric qualifiers, and allows 4,096 output tokens per question. It now compiles Evaluate strategy into source-grounded editing operations, rejects exact/near-copy candidates in Python, and uses deterministic first generation plus sampled corrections. Five- and seven-attempt live comparisons led to a final five-attempt ceiling: five-attempt runs revised 13/15 answers with 24.886s mean and 26.422s p95, while seven attempts revised 19/21 with 25.437s mean but 38.755s p95 and the same two safe fallbacks. Documented semantic-attribution risks remain. Axis compare_score text is computed deterministically in code from applicant and DynamoDB pass-average scores. Routing string enum cleanup remains.

features.name: External AI/search/vector integrations
features.description: Use OpenAI models, Tavily, and S3 Vectors through service adapters.
features.evidence: Vector evaluation context added on 2026-06-02. K-EXAONE/Friendli reliability work passed 72 tests on 2026-08-11. On 2026-08-12 Upstage Embed 2 migration tooling and query support were verified, 1,991 Upstage vectors were regenerated into a verified local JSONL, and a local exact-cosine A/B showed directional gains over OpenAI on the cleaned 19-query proxy set with significant labeling caveats. On 2026-08-13 the saved 1,024-dimensional vectors were temporarily uploaded 1,991/1,991; the live application completed Upstage query embedding, S3 Top-3, three DynamoDB context reads, EXAONE evaluation/revision, and JSON report output. The temporary Upstage index was then deleted and the original 1,536-dimensional index was verified unchanged at 1,991 vectors. On 2026-08-29 the active runtime was unified on OpenAI: shared structured calls moved to Responses API, smart parsing retained its OpenAI nano/mini fallback, embeddings were fixed to the existing OpenAI 1,536-dimensional index, and 157 Python tests passed. Historical EXAONE/Upstage comparison tools remain isolated from runtime settings.

features.name: Data-backed company recommendations
features.description: Rank currently actionable companies from self-introduction evidence, historical successful-application score baselines, sample confidence, and verified live job requirements.
features.evidence: Implemented and live-verified on 2026-08-29 on feature/data-backed-company-recommendations. Added role evidence and X/Y/Z assessment, paginated company/track aggregation with default n>=10, DB-first company candidate ranking, active-job verification, and a transparent 50/40/10 score. Full Python suite passed 162 tests; live DynamoDB preflight found 38 engineering companies across 1,866 samples. A dotenv-loaded synthetic OpenAI/DynamoDB/Tavily request returned HTTP 200 in 43.110 seconds with three distinct recommendations and exact score sums. Quality is not yet approved: the selected postings had zero role contribution and no extracted requirements, and the LG Electronics result linked to a partner-company listing.
